why: run-release-checklist-gate.ps1 (LNCH-23) used to grep CHANGELOG.md's raw text for a heading matching the version being released. md-zero-2026-08-11 PLAN.md Phase 3 (forced item 2/2, per explicit direction not to defer): CHANGELOG.md itself stays hand-authored prose -- unlike OPEN_ITEMS.md or the maturity-max-roadmap docs, a changelog's own content IS the artifact being verified, so generating it from a second JSON source would just move the 'did the changelog actually get updated' question to 'did the JSON get updated', not answer it. Instead this file is the small, explicit, human-maintained checklist item: append the version here in the SAME commit CHANGELOG.md gets its new heading (see docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md). The gate checks membership here, never CHANGELOG.md's text. Discovered while making this change: CHANGELOG.md itself is stale -- only beta1.8 has a real dated heading; every release since (beta1.9 through at least beta1.15, per recent commit history) landed without one, everything accumulating under '## [Unreleased]' instead. That is a pre-existing release-process gap, out of scope for this plan (this gate is manual-runbook, not wired into the actual release pipeline, so nothing enforced it) -- recorded here rather than silently worked around by inventing versions CHANGELOG.md never actually described.
